 What happened to Bam Adebayo? Heat star suffers scary injury vs Rockets 
 2026-11-17 02:09 
 Bam Adebayo sustained a right hip tightness and is questionable to return for Miami Heat vs. Houston Rockets.
 Credit: Getty Images via AFP - Scanpix 
 Credit Getty Images via AFP - Scanpix 
 Credit Getty Images via AFP - Scanpix 
 Add us on 
 Add us on 
 After being tagged as questionable to return, Bam Adebayo will no longer play in the Miami Heat's Monday home game against the Houston Rockets.

 The Heat announced that he is dealing with right hip tightness.
 Bam Adebayo suffers hip injury for Miami Heat, will not return vs. Rockets
 Miami dominated Houston throughout the evening, leading 101-81 to start the final frame. Amid concerns surrounding Bam Adebayo, the Heat made the right decision to keep the big man out for the rest of the game.
 Andrew Wiggins replaced Adebayo in the team's starting lineup entering the second half. Bobby Portis is also set to earn more minutes to help Giannis Antetokounmpo at the frontcourt for Miami.
 Adebayo made his last appearance for Miami with 32.8 seconds left in the first half before he was substituted out by Erik Spoelstra ahead of halftime.
 He was not present on the Heat's bench as the team returned to the court for the start of the third quarter against the Rockets.
 The star big man finished with four points, two assists, two steals, and one rebound in 16 minutes before leaving. Updates will be given once available.
